extension.summary: Browse your own media and debrid clouds on the Gamers Revolution Network.
extension.description: GRN Shows indexes metadata from TMDb and Trakt and plays back content you already own or have a subscription to. It hosts no media of its own.
extension.disclaimer: GRN Shows hosts no media and has no affiliation with any content provider. Use only sources and content you are authorized to access.
extension.news: v3.2.1 - Updates now come only from the GRN Shows repository - Make the GitHub-hosted repository installable, with a working catalogue - Publish a new version whenever the add-on changes
